Wax: toggle.description: A switch on a window, section or overlay

Wax: slider.description: A slider that shows its value

Wax: task loop.description: Code that runs again and again while you play. It stops when the mod reloads.

Wax: notification.description: A short message in a corner of the screen

Wax: overlay.description: A panel that stays on screen while you play

Wax: saved settings.description: Settings that are still there the next time the game starts

Wax: hotkey.description: Run code when a key is pressed during play
